text: Trainline plc listed on the London Stock Exchange's main market in 2019. Its notified major shareholders as of 25 September 2026 are institutional investors — FIL Limited 14.32%, BlackRock 6.15%, JPMorgan Asset Management 5.72%, Aviva 5.35%, J.P. Morgan Securities 5.05%, Ninety One 5.04% — with no state or state-fund holder.
